lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical white segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is widest at the posterior end (~150 pixels) and decreases significantly toward the anterior section where lines become faint and irregular.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 5th lines from the posterior terminate mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral fringe or the dorsal mane.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is located on the lateral haunch, centered above the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb are aligned on a near-horizontal axis, parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate trajectory with a strong lateral flare of approximately 40 degrees from the vertical axis before curving inward and upward toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.2 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12 percent of the total visible horn length from the apex downward.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers; one located on the dorsal ridge (mid-back) and one located near the ventral-posterior junction (underbelly).
